summary: Youlife Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the establishment of the Future International Vocational Education Research Institute (FIIVE), a think tank for vocational education. No specific deal terms, financial data, or special-situation event were provided; the press release describes the institute's mission, ten core research domains, and strategic alignment with global vocational trends. This is a routine business initiative without any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change. The filing is purely operational in nature.
